incidents.summary: Softcat failed to comply with packaging-waste regulations from 2007 to 2020 and agreed to pay £35,803.99 to an environmental charity and introduce compliance measures.

sources.title: Softcat and La-Z-Boy slapped with civil sanctions for recycling laziness | The Markets
sources.quote: Softcat PLC (LSE:SCT) has agreed to pay a penalty to an environmental charity after the Environment Agency found it had failed to comply with recycling laws for more than a decade.

sources.title: Softcat and La-Z-Boy slapped with civil sanctions for recycling laziness | The Markets
sources.quote: From 2007 until 2020 it had neither registered with the Environment Agency nor taken reasonable steps to recover and recycle packaging waste, contravening regulations.

sources.title: Softcat and La-Z-Boy slapped with civil sanctions for recycling laziness | The Markets
sources.quote: pledged £35,803.99 to the National Trust's Langham Pond wetland boardwalk project and will now register with a compliance scheme, implement a new written procedure, assign a responsible person and cover the Environment Agency’s costs.

positives: Softcat was reported to have achieved carbon neutrality after reducing CO2 emissions by 37% over five years.
Softcat's Marlow headquarters was reported to run entirely on renewable energy.
